services.desc: Looking for a show-stopping moment that your guests will be talking about for years? Fly Heli's helicopter drop services bring an unmatched level of excitement and spectacle to any event. Whether you are hosting a charity golf tournament, a community festival, a corporate gathering, or a special celebration, a helicopter drop transforms an ordinary event into an extraordinary one. Our experienced pilots deliver precise, coordinated drops over your venue, ensuring a safe and thrilling experience for everyone on the ground. blurb: Guests take helicopter flights over downtown St. Petersburg, Tampa Bay, and the Gulf Coast, enjoying aerial views of city skylines, waterfronts, beaches, and resorts. Flights are FAA-compliant, fully insured, and led by experienced pilots. Tours offer photo opportunities and a bird’s eye perspective of the region's landmarks and coastline.
extraNote: Arrive 10-15 minutes before reservation time for check-in · Reservation time is check-in time, not exact flight departure time · Late arrival over 10 minutes incurs $25 fee payable before boarding; no refund if denied boarding · Flights may be cancelled or delayed due to unsafe weather at pilot's discretion · Weather insurance available for full refund excluding insurance cost if cancelled due to weather
